text: Today I learned that these three things are all tools for clear, respectful communication. A correction, like you did with our appointment time, is a direct way to fix a mistake and build trust by preventing confusion. A suggestion should be framed with tentative language, like "this is just a possibility," to make it clear it's an idea for discussion, not a promise. And a confirmed arrangement is the final step, which I can verify with a summarizing question like, "Just to confirm, we've agreed on Friday at 18:20, right?" Each one has a different purpose, but they all work together to make sure everyone is on the same page.
